headline: Seagate Technology Holdings (STX) Falls On Tariffs As Fair Value Stays In Focus
summary: Seagate Technology Holdings (STX) is back in focus after new U.S. tariffs on key semiconductor trading partners and a sector wide pullback in chip and hardware stocks, as investors also brace for the upcoming earnings report. See our latest analysis for Seagate Technology Holdings. Despite the recent pullback and a 1-day share price decline of 6.75% as tariffs and sector weakness hit semiconductor stocks, Seagate Technology Holdings still shows strong momentum, with a 90-day share price...
